idea-plugin.name: CopyForLlm+
idea-plugin.description:
A fork of AykoSc/copyforllm that adds sensitive-file/folder exclusion.
Copies selected files and folders structure and content to the clipboard, formatted for easy pasting into Large Language Models (LLMs).
Features:
  • Generates a file tree of the selection relative to the project root.
  • Includes file content with language-specific comment headers showing project-relative paths.
  • Skips binary and empty file content but includes them in the tree/header.
  • Settings > Tools > CopyForLlm: configure filename/path patterns (files or whole folders, e.g. ".env", "node_modules", "secrets") that stay visible in the tree but are left out of the copied content entirely.
Right-click on files/folders in the Project view and select "Copy for LLM".
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0
  • Added a Settings > Tools > CopyForLlm page to configure exclusion patterns (files or whole folders, e.g. ".env", "node_modules", "secrets"). A match always stays visible in the tree but is left out of the copied content entirely.
  • ".env" and "node_modules" are excluded by default.

1.0.1
  • Added character count to clipboard copy notification.
  • Updated compatibility range.
  • Fixed internal API usage warning.

1.0.0
  • Initial release of CopyForLlm.
  • Copies selected file/folder structure and content to clipboard.
  • Formats output with tree structure and file content headers for LLMs.
  • Handles basic language comment styles.
  • Skips binary/empty files.
